proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13544.1 sūkara gives Pali sūkara, Prakrit sūara, Bengali suor and Bhojpuri sūwar pig. Selected Bengali śukor/ʃukor preserve the velar (possible learned/contact influence), Bishnupriya huor has regional sibilant weakening to h, and Tharu suɹa/suwər/sura match the contracted branch. These are qualified family links, without a claim to a settled immediate Indo-Aryan donor or identical transmission history. Exact response: suɹa.
